metadata.description: Agentic extensions for Financial Portfolios AI subscribers — interact with your model portfolios, run analysis and visualizations, and prepare broker orders, all from an LLM client via MCP.

plugins.name: financial-portfolios
plugins.description: Connect to your Financial Portfolios AI account (MCP) and explore, analyze and visualize your model portfolios — holdings, allocations, history, performance, drift — and put the companies they hold in context with your market-data or news MCP, every outside fact attributed.

plugins.name: financial-portfolios-broker
plugins.description: Convert a Financial Portfolios AI model portfolio into reviewable order tickets and hand them to a brokerage MCP (Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Alpaca, …) — propose → confirm, never auto-execute. A separate install because it is the only plugin that prepares orders.
